newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS START OF LEICESTERSHIRE V AUSTRALIA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS START OF LEICESTERSHIRE V AUSTRALIA MATCH.

text.p: play before lunch on the opening day of Australia's three-day
tour match against Leicestershire on Saturday.
